completion_requirements: same ac_pipeline specialization, 128 threads, request width, cache policy, stage count and launch geometry as the frozen case
input_word=uint32(17*word_index+seed) across the complete shared 8MiB read-only input array
fresh cudaMemset poison sums/final_slots/trace before each launch; all stamp bytes=0xff before each short launch; no explicit auxiliary kernel
CUDA launch and completion event synchronization succeed; all stamp fields overwritten, smid in device range, all launched CTA entries checked
preserve producer wait, consumer CTA barrier, release CTA barrier, decreasing tail waits and final wait0/CTA barrier; device source bytes unchanged
all trace words, each thread modular sum and every final-slot word compared exactly with the independent host oracle
stamp values may have zero-duration intervals; positive elapsed time and all physical SM coverage are not acceptance criteria
stop after first CUDA/completion/numerical failure; emit partial failed validation when possible and exit nonzero

declared_output_check.method: all consumed uint32 trace words, all uint32 thread modular sums, and all uint32 final-slot words
declared_output_check.poison: sum/final/trace bytes=0xa5; stamp bytes=0xff before launch; compare every declared output, no sampling

profiles.output_evidence_limit: all outputs are compared but values are not persisted; this evidence cannot support offline rechecking with a changed reference

resource_requirements.registers_per_thread: positive integer <=255; bound to actual B2 target compile
resource_requirements.occupancy_limit_ctas_per_sm: positive integer <=32; check necessary shared/register/thread capacity bounds
